title: RegistryMetadata
description: Metadata about the npm registry instance, following CouchDB database information conventions.

db_name.description: The name of the database, typically "registry".

doc_count.description: The total number of documents in the registry.

doc_del_count.description: The total number of deleted documents.

compact_running.description: Whether a database compaction is currently running.

instance_start_time.description: Timestamp of when this registry instance started.

disk_format_version.description: The version of the on-disk storage format.

committed_update_seq.description: The last committed update sequence number.
